evidence.title: CodeWaifu: caring coding desktop sprite | RobotWorld

name: CodeWaifu
summary: Desktop sprite companion that speaks coding-agent session events and keeps agent terminals alive through crashes.
description: A desktop companion for coding agents. Session starts, finishes and permission requests from Codex and Claude Code become spoken lines and speech bubbles through an offline Matcha-TTS voice with frame-locked lip sync, and the sprite can stand on the wallpaper or beside your terminals. A Pro bench built on the herdr terminal runtime gathers agent terminals, ssh sessions and local shells into one tree, backed by an fsync'd intent ledger that resumes work after a close, crash, sleep or reboot.
contains: desktop sprite voiced by offline Matcha-TTS with frame-locked lip sync (mixed Chinese and English)
session events from Codex and Claude Code spoken aloud
Pro bench gathers agent terminals, ssh tool and local shell into one tree
herdr owns the PTYs, so terminals survive closing the app, crashes and sleep
fsync'd intent ledger stores goal, decisions, next action, branch and workdir
one-command install for macOS, Windows and Linux
